description: A battalion executive officer must publish the next-day access and escort plan for four routine technical service visits at a sustainment compound, assigning each visitor an entry gate, access window, and escort arrangement.

shared_context.S1: Four routine service visits are scheduled for tomorrow: a generator-inspection team, a fire-suppression inspection team, a network-maintenance team, and a clinic refrigeration technician.
shared_context.S2: The compound has North Gate and Service Gate; all visitors must be recorded before entry and escorted to their work location.
shared_context.S3: North Gate is normally used for general visitors, while Service Gate is normally used for technical deliveries and maintenance teams.
shared_context.S4: The installation access-control policy requires the battalion executive officer to publish the next-day visitor plan after the routine morning access huddle.
shared_context.S5: The morning access huddle includes the security, facilities, signal-support, and medical-logistics representatives, who review changes to scheduled visits before the plan is published.

PF1.text: The security desk confirmed this morning that the fire-suppression inspection team has temporary credentials valid only at North Gate from 0830 to 0930 and requires a security escort; the credential note is still in the desk log and has not been added to the visitor worksheet.

PF2.text: Facilities confirmed that the generator-inspection team must enter through Service Gate from 1000 to 1100 because the generator yard is closed to North Gate traffic during its morning vehicle check; the closure was posted on the facilities board but not sent to the access desk.

PF3.text: The network-maintenance team must use North Gate from 1300 to 1400 because its contractor vehicle is too tall for the Service Gate clearance bar, and a signal-support escort is required; the vehicle measurement was verified today but the access plan has not been updated.

PF4.text: The clinic refrigeration technician must use Service Gate from 1400 to 1500 and be escorted by medical logistics directly to the clinic cold room because the technician is carrying a temperature-controlled replacement module; the appointment confirmation arrived after the last access worksheet was printed.

acceptance_conditions: The fire-suppression inspection team must be assigned North Gate from 0830 to 0930.
The generator-inspection team must be assigned Service Gate from 1000 to 1100.
The network-maintenance team must be assigned North Gate from 1300 to 1400.
The clinic refrigeration technician must be assigned Service Gate from 1400 to 1500.
A security escort commitment must exist for the fire-suppression inspection team.
A facilities access-coordination commitment must exist for the generator-inspection team.
A signal-support escort commitment must exist for the network-maintenance team.
A medical-logistics direct-escort commitment must exist for the clinic refrigeration technician.
The temporary-credential requirement must be cited as a justification.

content_checks.C5: any('security escort' in c['detail'] and c['target'] == 'fire-suppression inspection team' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('Service Gate' in c['detail'] and '1000' in c['detail'] and c['target'] == 'generator-inspection team' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('signal-support escort' in c['detail'] or 'signal support escort' in c['detail']) and c['target'] == 'network-maintenance team' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(('medical logistics escort' in c['detail'] or 'medical-logistics escort' in c['detail']) and c['target'] == 'clinic refrigeration technician' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The temporary credential changes the fire-suppression team's gate to North Gate, fixes its window at 0830-0930, and requires a security escort.
The generator-yard closure changes the generator-inspection team's gate to Service Gate, fixes its window at 1000-1100, and requires facilities access coordination.
The contractor vehicle's clearance restriction changes the network-maintenance team's gate to North Gate, fixes its window at 1300-1400, and requires a signal-support escort.
The temperature-controlled module appointment changes the clinic technician's gate to Service Gate, fixes its window at 1400-1500, and requires direct medical-logistics escort to the cold room.
